title: I Built a $5K/Month Claude AI System for Car Dealerships #shorts #claude #automatedsystem
description:
In this video, I break down a $5,000/month Claude AI system that can help car dealerships completely automate their marketing, optimize their lot inventory, and structure finance deals on autopilot.

This system functions as a multi-agent team overseen by a central director called Claude Code. It starts with the Marketing and Sales agent posting daily updates and pushing qualified DMs straight into the CRM. From there, the Inventory agent watches the lot to analyze pricing and recommend wholesale or auction moves, while the Finance agent structures payment options and preps lender paperwork before the customer even sits down in the box. Every morning, the director drops a consolidated report right on the GM's desk.

This is for AI agency owners, automation consultants, dealership GMs, and anyone who wants to understand how AI agents can be used to run a massive, multi-department retail operation.

If you are interested in using Claude, AI automation, or grabbing the full AI agent system blueprint for dealerships, this video shows the full concept. Please follow and find the link in the pinned comment!
